source.quote: Safety evaluations of Gemini 3.1 Pro produced results consistent with the original Gemini 3 Pro safety assessment.

findings.text: Safety deltas use improved internal evals and are not directly comparable to prior Gemini model cards.

source.quote: The performance results reported below are computed with improved evaluations and thus are not directly comparable with performance results found in previous Gemini model cards.

findings.text: Manual review found automated safety losses were mostly false positives or not egregious.

source.quote: Our manual review confirmed losses were overwhelmingly either a) false positives or b) not egregious.

findings.text: With Deep Think, cyber performance is worse after accounting for inference cost; high inference does not exceed non-Deep Think.

findings.text: On situational awareness, almost 100% success on max tokens, context size mod, and oversight frequency; overall still below alert threshold.

notes: Source is the DeepMind web model card (seed URL); a PDF exists at storage.googleapis.com/deepmind-media/Model-Cards/Gemini-3-1-Pro-Model-Card.pdf with the same content. Much architecture/training/limitations/safety-policy detail is deferred to the Gemini 3 Pro model card (basedOn). Capability table columns mapped to seed ids: Gemini 3.1 Pro Thinking (High), Gemini 3 Pro Thinking (High), Sonnet 4.6, Opus 4.6, GPT-5.2, GPT-5.3-Codex. Safety table values are percentage-point deltas vs Gemini 3 Pro, not absolute rates. FSF situational-awareness 'almost 100%' recorded as 100 percent with that caveat in settings. No named external testers (METR/AISI/etc.); red teaming described as internal specialist teams. Additional methodology page deepmind.google/models/evals-methodology/gemini-3-1-pro not extracted.
